basis: Intellectual disability and marked cubitus valgus define the syndrome. Common benign nevi and facial morphology do not establish additional organ damage.

decisions.dermatologic: none: nevi occur in 80-99%, but benign nevi alone do not establish damaging skin disease or a primary dermatologic disorder.

basis: Congenital cerebellar dysfunction; muscle atrophy in 3/5 and pes planus in 5/5 support musculoskeletal involvement. Strabismus and nystagmus reflect ocular motor dysfunction.

decisions.ocular: none: strabismus (4/5) and nystagmus are ocular motor manifestations of cerebellar disease; direct damage to the eye is not established.

basis: Glycosylation defect with severe neurologic disease in 3/3; renal cortical cysts in 1/3 (~33%). Specific skin lesions and optic atrophy are annotated at 5-29%.

decisions.renal: involved: renal cortical cysts are direct structural renal lesions, reported in 1/3 (~33%); the available estimate meets the threshold.
decisions.ocular: none: optic atrophy is occasional (5-29%); unspecified ocular anomalies and ocular motor signs do not establish common direct ocular damage.
decisions.dermatologic: none: specific skin diseases are annotated as occasional (5-29%); the broad definition does not establish a major diagnostic skin criterion.

basis: Urinary malformations and absent abdominal musculature define disease; lung hypoplasia is annotated at 80-99%. Xerostomia in a selected 6-patient series is not established across the syndrome.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: xerostomia in 6/6 reflects a small, selected CHRM3-associated series; common salivary dysfunction across the prune-belly umbrella is not established.

basis: Congenital viral brain injury; destructive retinal/macular and optic nerve lesions affect roughly 30-50% of syndromic cases. Hearing loss and contractures are less consistently present.

decisions.ocular: involved: retinal scarring and optic nerve injury directly impair vision in roughly 30-50% of congenital syndromic cases; they are associated organ damage.

basis: Both kidneys are dysplastic and nonfunctional; fetal anuria causes anhydramnios and pulmonary hypoplasia in most untreated pregnancies with this lethal bilateral form.

decisions.pulmonary: involved: pulmonary hypoplasia is an integral developmental consequence of fetal anuria/anhydramnios in most cases (>30%), rather than a later unrelated risk.

basis: The supplied definition specifies apple-peel atresia with deficient mesenteric arterial supply; persistent vascular malformation is integral and annotated at 30-79%.

decisions.cardiovascular: involved: the defined apple-peel form has persistent deficient mesenteric arterial anatomy, not merely a hypothesized past trigger; vascular abnormalities occur in 30-79%.

basis: Ulnar/radial hypoplasia and absent digits define the syndrome. Oral clefts, dental anomalies and hydronephrosis have no established frequency or diagnostic requirement.

decisions.gastrointestinal: none: cleft lip/palate and dental anomalies are reported without frequency; neither prevalence >=30% nor a major diagnostic oral criterion is established.

basis: Storage disorder defined by dysostosis/contractures and corneal clouding (28/28 each); valve damage in 27/28 (~96%). Cap omits common airway, ear and skin involvement.

decisions.ocular: primary: corneal stromal clouding is a defining MPS VI feature, present in 28/28, with direct visual impairment.
decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: characteristic dysostosis multiplex and progressive joint contractures define the phenotype; contractures occur in 28/28.

basis: Bilirubin directly injures the neonatal brain; persistent auditory neuropathy/hearing loss is a major diagnostic feature of chronic kernicterus. No intrinsic hepatic disease is implied.

decisions.otologic: involved: persistent auditory neuropathy/hearing loss is a major diagnostic feature of chronic bilirubin brain injury, supporting inclusion without a numerical frequency.
